rules.description:
HTTPX2 is now the default HTTP client, and httpx is no longer installed automatically. Applications using custom HTTPX clients must migrate to their HTTPX2 equivalents.
Validation concerns: Rename classification conflicts with a structural/configuration description.
rules.example_before: import httpx\nfrom openai import OpenAI\nclient = OpenAI(http_client=httpx.Client())
rules.example_after: import httpx2\nfrom openai import OpenAI\nclient = OpenAI(http_client=httpx2.Client())
rules.evidence:
Replace HTTPX-specific objects with the corresponding HTTPX2 objects:

Previous object
HTTPX2 object
httpx.Client
httpx2.Client
